# EverSafe Fire Protection

> Florida-licensed fire protection engineering practice providing PE-stamped fire sprinkler and fire alarm designs, third-party plan review, fire code consulting, and fire/smoke modeling for commercial and industrial projects across Florida.

## Services

- [Fire Sprinkler System Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-sprinkler-system-design.html): Hydraulic calculations and PE-stamped sprinkler drawings for new construction and retrofits.
- [Fire Alarm System Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-alarm-system-design.html): Code-compliant fire alarm and detection system design with PE stamp.
- [PE Stamping & Third-Party Plan Review](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/pe-stamping-plan-review.html): Independent PE review and stamping of sprinkler and alarm plans for permit submittal.
- [Fire Code Consulting](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-code-consulting-florida.html): Florida Fire Prevention Code and NFPA compliance consulting for design teams and building owners.
- [Fire & Smoke Modeling](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/fire-smoke-modeling-florida.html): Performance-based fire and smoke modeling to support AHJ approvals.
- [Special Hazards Design](https://www.eversafe-fire.com/special-hazards-design-florida.html): Clean-agent, foam, and other special suppression systems for mission-critical facilities.

## Who We Serve

MEP engineering firms, commercial and industrial general contractors, design-build fire sprinkler and alarm contractors, architects, and building owners.

## Service Area

Based in Oviedo, Florida (Central Florida); serving projects statewide across Florida.

## Key Facts

- Florida-licensed Professional Engineer; PE-stamped, permit-ready submittals.
- Fixed-fee proposals with typical one-business-day turnaround.
- Third-party plan review independent of the installing contractor.
